verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's core product is a single-page scraping API; the only evidence of whole-site crawling is a CLI subcommand (`scrapingbee crawl`) that does 'same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider', which is a separate tool invocation rather than 'one request' to the scraping API itself. missing for 10: a documented single API call/endpoint that crawls an entire site, details on crawl configuration/limits, and independent/hands-on evidence the CLI crawl works reliably at scale.
